items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-25
items.q: And then Marie Carl was down there. Four or five young women down in the break-sized three hours or something. And he was showing the tickets to everybody.

ctx.x: Well, sometimes on those older records, they don't play 4-4, they play... What is it? Double record. Boy, at the night, there was a lot of people. Frank... Lauren, this is here, there was a lot of people. Sex. Go ahead and take the telephone. Lauren used to do it, a lot of times. And he kept... All the bands that I can show you, I know. Two men bands at the best time. You know that? It's a band of sales and... Or... Or the Kimber. Or the... Or the... Orubaloo. Orubaloo comes more... Closer, you don't know…

until he wasn't there. The band was sitting to the beach, so that's the same thing. Mr. Father Joseph wanted to pay sale. I had a way to band, but I was on the way to get... He used to come by and he'd make sure that I was in a beam. He couldn't get a part big enough to put him in a brand new chamber part. And we got along pretty close. But nothing comes right to Andrew and he was in a band room. Everybody has known their own, you know, wants to. And he went down to the band room. And they would pick a tune,…

I would run a little bit of a winch. I would run a winch. I would truck a car and a big. It's not a one big car and it's a way to put it on the truck. It's balanced to catch an average in the middle. It's balanced to truck in all fields. I went to camped up on nothing but the Norwegian. I would turn it over to be a wire. Power wire. I never knew it. I would dig for the car. Dig for the car. Just put it out and put it on the sling. I've done water bottles. I've done sacks. Sacks. Sacks what? I was just a little…
